CRM Quote Request — Before Validate — Auto Promote Status
script:
if doc.is_superseded:
    frappe.throw(_("This quote request has been superseded and cannot be modified."))

old_doc = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_status = old_doc.status if old_doc else None

# Auto-promote: Estimation attached the file in Pending or Revision Requested
# state — flip to Quote Received. Covers both first-round upload AND every
# revision-round re-upload. Without the Revision Requested case, round 2 would
# never advance and Script 5's downstream task/notification work wouldn't fire.
#
# MUST run in Before Validate (not Before Save) so the subsequent validate()
# phase evaluates mandatory_depends_on against the NEW status — otherwise
# quote_value / quote_margin would not be enforced and the save would commit
# with NULLs.
if (
    old_doc is not None
    and old_status in ("Pending", "Revision Requested")
    and doc.status == old_status
    and doc.quote_file
):
    doc.status = "Quote Received"

# Positive-value guard: mandatory_depends_on cannot catch Currency/Percent
# default 0.0, so explicitly reject zero/negative quote_value or quote_margin
# whenever the QR is no longer Pending. Idempotent for Quote Received -> Accepted /
# Revision Requested moves because the values are already populated at that point.
if doc.status != "Pending":
    if not doc.quote_value or doc.quote_value <= 0:
        frappe.throw(_("Quote Value must be greater than 0."), title=_("Quote Value Required"))
    if not doc.quote_margin or doc.quote_margin <= 0:
        frappe.throw(_("Quote Margin must be greater than 0."), title=_("Quote Margin Required"))
    if not doc.quote_sq_ft or doc.quote_sq_ft <= 0:
        frappe.throw(_("Quote Area (sqft) must be greater than 0."), title=_("Quote Area Required"))
    if not doc.quote_number or not str(doc.quote_number).strip():
        frappe.throw(_("External Quote No. is required."), title=_("Quote Number Required"))

script:
# Skip during stock-Frappe test fixture loads. test_records.json for CRM Lead
# ships ~35 leads with overlapping mobiles when re-inserted across test-class
# setUp invocations; Frappe's ignore_if_duplicate catches the DB-level conflict
# but server scripts run earlier and would block fixture loading. IndiFrame
# tests in crm/tests/ exercise this dedup explicitly with realistic data.
# Test docs use Frappe's `_T-` naming prefix — a reliable signal inside safe_exec
# (frappe.flags is not exposed in the server-script sandbox).
if doc.name and str(doc.name).startswith("_T-"):
    pass
elif doc.mobile_no:
    # Normalize to E.164 once at the save boundary so admin UI, API, and
    # fixture inserts all dedup against the same canonical form. Website
    # already pre-normalizes (crm/api/website.py:_normalize_phone) so this
    # is idempotent for that path.
    try:
        parsed = frappe.get_attr("crm.utils.parse_phone_number")(doc.mobile_no)
        if parsed and parsed.get("success") and parsed.get("is_valid"):
            doc.mobile_no = parsed["formats"]["E164"]
    except Exception:
        # Normalization failure is non-fatal — fall through to exact-match
        # dedup on the raw value. Caller-side validation handles bad input.
        pass

    existing = frappe.db.get_value(
        "CRM Lead",
        {"mobile_no": doc.mobile_no, "name": ["!=", doc.name]},
        ["name", "lead_name", "status", "lead_status"],
        as_dict=True,
    )
    if existing:
        hint_by_lead_status = {
            "Cold-Unresponsive": "Use the Reactivation flow.",
            "Archived": "Use the Reactivation flow.",
        }
        hint_by_status = {
            "C6": "Lead is marked Lost — investigate before creating a new lead.",
            "C4": "This number is already a customer.",
        }
        hint = hint_by_lead_status.get(existing.lead_status) or hint_by_status.get(existing.status, "")
        message = (
            f"A lead with mobile {doc.mobile_no} already exists: "
            f"{existing.lead_name} ({existing.name}) — Stage: {existing.status} / {existing.lead_status}."
        )
        if hint:
            message += " " + hint
        frappe.throw(_(message), title=_("Duplicate Mobile Number"))

script:
# Per-stage mandatory-field requirements. Edit this block to add/remove
# required fields at each transition without a code deploy.
#
# Migrated from CRMLead Python validators (validate_won_fields,
# validate_c4_handoff_fields, validate_c7_routing_reason,
# validate_partner_fabricator_name, validate_sub_source) on 2026-05-21.
# `validate_lost_reason` stays in Python because it has a UI side-effect
# (rebuilds the side-panel section). `validate_project_specific_fields`
# stays because it's called from crm.api.projects, not from validate().

WON_TYPE_FIELDS = (
    ("custom_final_quote", "Final Quote"),
    ("custom_final_price", "Final Price"),
    ("custom_final_margin", "Final Margin"),
)

C4_HANDOFF_FIELDS = (
    ("email", "Email"),
    ("custom_lead_type", "Lead Type"),
    ("custom_customer_type", "Customer Type"),
    ("custom_city", "City"),
    ("custom_state", "State"),
    ("custom_pincode", "Pincode"),
)

C7_ROUTING_FIELDS = (
    ("custom_fabricator_routing_reason", "Fabricator Routing Reason"),
    ("custom_partner_fabricator_name", "Partner Fabricator Name"),
)

SUB_SOURCE_TRIGGER_SOURCES = {"Referral", "Channel Partner", "Event", "Chat", "Lead Spotting"}

# Won-type stages: final quote / price / margin must be present. Fires for
# any CRM Lead Status whose `type` is "Won" (currently C4; future Won-type
# statuses would auto-include).
#
# NOTE: uses db.get_value, not get_cached_value — the safe_exec sandbox does
# not expose frappe.get_cached_value (same shape as the frappe.get_attr gap;
# see admin-ui-setup-guide.md §17.5).
if doc.status and frappe.db.get_value("CRM Lead Status", doc.status, "type") == "Won":
    # NOTE: explicit for-loop instead of a list comprehension. RestrictedPython's
    # safe_exec runs comprehensions in their own scope, which can't see the
    # outer `doc` name → NameError at runtime. Same shape applies below.
    missing = []
    for field, label in WON_TYPE_FIELDS:
        if not doc.get(field):
            missing.append(label)
    if missing:
        # NOTE: f-string inside _() instead of .format() — safe_exec marks
        # str.format as an unsafe attribute, so .format() raises SyntaxError
        # before the script even runs.
        missing_list = ", ".join(missing)
        frappe.throw(
            _(f"Required for Won stages: {missing_list}."),
            frappe.ValidationError,
        )

# C4-specific handoff fields (Retail + Projects). Hardcoded `status == "C4"`
# because validate_project_specific_fields (in crm/api/projects.py) keys off
# the same string. If C4 is ever renamed, both spots need to update.
if doc.status == "C4":
    c4_missing = []
    for field, label in C4_HANDOFF_FIELDS:
        if not doc.get(field):
            c4_missing.append(label)
    if c4_missing:
        c4missing_list = ", ".join(c4_missing)
        frappe.throw(
            _(f"Required at C4 (Won): {c4missing_list}."),
            frappe.ValidationError,
        )

# C7 routing fields (both routing reason and partner fabricator name).
if doc.status == "C7":
    c7_missing = []
    for field, label in C7_ROUTING_FIELDS:
        if not doc.get(field):
            c7_missing.append(label)
    if c7_missing:
        c7missing_list = ", ".join(c7_missing)
        frappe.throw(
            _(f"Required at C7 (Forwarded to Fabricator): {c7missing_list}."),
            frappe.ValidationError,
        )

# Sub-source required when source is one of the referral-like set. Skip
# during in-test (stock Frappe test fixtures don't set sub_source).
if not frappe.flags.in_test:
    if doc.source in SUB_SOURCE_TRIGGER_SOURCES and not doc.get("custom_sub_source"):
        src = doc.source
        frappe.throw(
            _(f"Sub Source is required when Source is {src}."),
            frappe.ValidationError,
        )
